dataset.name: BNCI 008-2014 · public P300 speller
dataset.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 · Santa Lucia Neuroelectrical Imaging and BCI Laboratory
dataset.paradigm: 6×6 row/column highlights; ten repetitions; 250 ms stimulus onset interval

method.training: First three participants A01–A03 fixed before fitting. Separate model per participant: first 15 selections train, final 20 test. No test-label fitting or tuning.
method.features: Same feature extractor and estimator as the live prototype: 3rd-order Butterworth 1–15 Hz, -200–0 ms baseline, sixteen 50 ms bins over 0–800 ms, training-only scaler and class-balanced logistic regression C=0.1. Trials filtered independently.
method.quality: Same raw limits as live: 300 µV peak-to-peak maximum and 0.01 µV minimum SD. Any failed epoch rejects the whole selection. Rejected/abstained test selections stay in the accuracy denominator.
method.selection: Average target-response probabilities separately across six rows and six columns. Both winning score margins must reach 0.05. This row/column adapter differs from the live single-item protocol.

findings: All 10 ANT recordings contain Fz, Pz, P3 and P4.
Shared electrode names and ERP feature definitions support software compatibility testing.
Existing ANT movement/imagery analyses remain separate from this letter-selection benchmark.
unsupported: ANT recordings have movement annotations, not letter-flash targets; P300 decoding accuracy cannot be calculated from them.
Electrode overlap does not establish waveform correlation, cross-person model transfer, or successful calibration of your cap.
Public data use 256 Hz, a right-earlobe reference and different acquisition hardware; ANT recordings use 500/1000 Hz.
Public six-by-six row/column flashes differ from the live three-by-three individual flashes.

figures.title: Measured calibration responses
figures.description: Attended and unattended responses at four shared electrodes; training data only.

figures.title: Held-out letter selection
figures.description: All 20 later trials per participant; errors and abstentions retained.

limitations: Results describe these three recorded participants only; they are not accuracy on your ANT setup.
The replay shows stored classifier predictions from real held-out EEG. It does not react to a viewer’s thoughts.
This benchmark never unlocks the live EEG calibration gate or installs its models in the cap connection.
A small, fixed subset is used. No claim of across-participant generalization is made.
Known target labels are used to score predictions and show the answer, not as inputs to the inference function.

provenance.subjects_rule: First three numeric subject IDs, fixed before evaluating.
provenance.mapping: MAT classes_stim explicitly identifies codes 1–6 as Row1–Row6 and 7–12 as Col1–Col6. This overrides the transposed illustration in the description PDF. Matrix alphabet from that figure.
provenance.marker_rule: Rising edges of 32-sample marker pulses, not every nonzero sample; MATLAB trial indices converted to zero-based.
